description: Operation history for a subgraph (deploy/reindex/backfill/stop), newest first — status, block range, progress, and error. THIS IS THE VERIFY CALL: after subgraphs_deploy, subgraphs_reindex, subgraphs_backfill, or subgraphs_stop, poll it with the returned operationId until `status` is terminal (completed/failed/cancelled) before reporting success. Omit operationId for the recent history.

operationId.description: Fetch one operation by id (the operationId returned by reindex/backfill/stop); omit for recent history

name: subgraphs_operations
